title: Figure 12 (20629) Dyess long-range radar composite; Figure 13 Dublin Citizen clipping
description: Upper image is a NEXRAD composite reflectivity display from KDYX Dyess AFB, TX, timestamped 11/19/2009 01:07:40 GMT, with a dBZ legend and redacted coordinates (1843(a)(3)); caption: "Figure 12. (20629) Dyess long-range composite for 01:07:40 GMT-Yellow block is in line NE,E from witness position." Below is a clipping of the front page of The Dublin Citizen, Thursday, November 26, 2009, with the headline "Mystery lights are back!"; per the following page this is Figure 13, captioned "'Mystery Lights' article refer to the same sighting by another witness."
